_canonical: This file is the ONE source of truth for the emerald theme. src/theme.ts imports it; scripts/sync-brand.mjs copies it to shared/brand/tokens.json and --check fails the build on drift. Never edit the mirror.

layout.note: LAYOUT drives the VIDEO scenes' side margins and vertical rhythm. The image still uses measured auto-fill spacing (one uniform gap, never clips).

render.note: Images always render at --scale=4 (ultra-HD default); --scale=2 is the floor. Video stays at 2x.
